Brem is a trader in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.
“
Well don't you cut a fine figure. Want your portrait done? If you have the gold, my pet artist will make you a most heroical likeness.
„
— Brem

Involvement

Act One

Brem offers the interacting party member to have their portrait painted by  Oskar Fevras. The party can purchase Oscar's freedom, which advances ⁠Free the Artist. Brem and  Garias banter about Oscar and his art and family affairs.

Secret shop

These items are added to Brem's trade inventory if  Zarys is spoken to after gaining Zarys' trust through ⁠Find the Missing Shipment, which can be accomplished through delivering the unopened chest or by executing  Rugan after he betrays the Zhentarim. The player character cannot both take the chest and spare Rugan if they wish to have any of the items below. Without Zarys' approval, the items are unavailable to pickpocket, loot, or purchase.

Idle banter

Brem will occassionally chat with Garias about their prisoner:

  • Garias
    What's wrong with the artist?
  • Brem
    Besides the bleedin' obvious? He misses the sun.
  • Garias
    He what?
  • Brem
    Needs light to work, he says. We had a chat - turns out he needs his eyes more.
  • Garias
    Did that artist really paint all those things?
  • Brem
    Says he did, yeah.
  • Garias
    Why?
  • Brem
    Says his muse made him do it.
  • Garias
    Who's that, then?
  • Brem
    Gods, little brother - read a bleedin' book.
  • Garias
    Here, make your fella draw me something.
  • Brem
    You got coin?
  • Garias
    Yeah, all right, fine. Who are you, his muse?
  • Brem
    Don't pretend you know what that means. What kind of drawin' you want?
  • Garias
    Birds.
  • Brem
    Like, any kind of birds, or...
  • Garias
    Pretty ones. With colours and stuff.

If the party freed Oskar:

  • Garias
    I miss watching your artist paint.
  • Brem
    I made a bucket of coins off him. When we get back to the gate, I'll take you to a museum.
  • Garias
    They got paintings in those?
  • Brem
    A few, yeah.
  • Brem
    Did I see you drawing something earlier?
  • Garias
    So? Can do a better job than that ponce you sold.
  • Brem
    Huh. Keep it up, little brother - might be I can sell yousome day.
  • Garias
    Aw.
  • Brem
    Like ma always wanted.

Notes

  • Despite being a ranger and having 3 spell slots, Brem does not have any ranger abilities or spells to make use of.
